rules.title: Health or safety outcome claim lacks approved substantiation

exceptions: clearly framed as a warning or quoted user claim, still requires review

rules.note: Escalate to BLOCK only when the approved rule or evidence review confirms the claim is prohibited or materially false.

rules.title: Creator or expert endorsement has missing disclosure or substantiation

semantic_conditions: endorsement, testimonial, expert claim, or material connection

rules.title: Claim conflicts with confirmed SKU fact

semantic_conditions: claim conflicts with SKU, model, region, or approved specification

rules.title: Objective product claim has no approved evidence

semantic_conditions: objective performance, capacity, safety, certification, or comparative claim lacks supporting record

rules.title: Absolute or ranking claim requires context and proof

semantic_conditions: objective superiority, ranking, or certification implication
exceptions: do not treat the mere presence of best/first as a US-wide automatic BLOCK; require platform scope, time window, methodology, and proof

rules.note: This is intentionally REVIEW in the US seed set; the PRD's absolute-word BLOCK rule needs US legal and platform-specific confirmation.
